# Netmore fixtures

`uplink_all.json` and `uplink_default.json` are the "Default (All)" and "Default" export format examples from docs.connect.netmoregroup.com (Export Format - Sensor Data), with the local simulator's DevEUI and an OpenCollar port 2 frame as payload. `downlink_response.json` is the MQTT downlink response example from the "Downlink using MQTT" page. Recorded messages from a Netmore account replace these; keep the origin here.
